submitter_note: Josh Crick, councillor, MD of Bonnyville
community: Saddle Lake, Frog Lake, Fishing Lake (Métis settlement)
request: suggests Saddle Lake, Frog Lake and Fishing Lake settlement could be moved out of Bonnyville-Cold Lake-St. Paul to shrink its size and population
quote: there’s Saddle Lake and then there’s also Frog Lake and Fishing Lake, the settlements. Those could be possible ways to readjust the size and population a bit.
note: Tentative suggestion ('could be possible ways'); no receiving district named. Later says he is not aware how integrated the reserves/settlements are with each other. Wife works on Frog Lake and Beaver Lake reserves; mentions Cold Lake First Nations, Kehewin in a list of councils. submitter_note: Scott Cyr, MLA, Bonnyville-Cold Lake-St. Paul
request: transfer Saddle Lake Cree Nation from Bonnyville-Cold Lake-St. Paul into Athabasca-Barrhead-Westlock to reduce his riding's population
quote: This proposal would transfer Saddle Lake Cree Nation into Athabasca-Barrhead-Westlock
note: Formal written proposal (May 22) restated. Acknowledges Saddle Lake relies on St. Paul services and describes a cluster 'Two Hills, St. Paul, Saddle Lake, Kehewin' (EB-175) but still proposes the move; says Saddle Lake leadership is more concerned with MPs/federal than MLAs. Also discusses Elizabeth and Fishing Lake Métis settlements (no move asked). Page = EB label printed after the passage (Hansard prints the label at the foot of each page).
